Capcom continues its run of bringing legacy titles to Switch 2, this time delivering three classic Resident Evil remakes to the Nintendo hybrid machine. In this video, Oliver focuses on the best of the bunch - Resident Evil 4 - while giving us some insights on the others. So, are we looking at something more like PS4 or PS5, or a hybrid release spanning the features of both eighth and ninth gen consoles?
